messages.subject: Violating the models by working with populations
messages.subject_clean: Violating the models by working with populations
messages.body_plain:
Dear Nick and fellow users of BioGeoBEARS,

I work with a dolphin species that practically lacks gene flow, past migration rates are less than one individual per generation. So it seems the populations are genetically isolated.
Is it possible to use BioGeoBEARS to infer the species biogeographic history using a phylogeny where the tips are the populations? I mean by collapsing the tips to reduce the tree to monophyletic populations.
Or do BioGeoBEARS models only work at the species level?

Thanks!
Luana Nara
